data.name: Artemis M128-16 128 KiB / 16-bit AION-qualified RAM module

specification.physical_arrangement: 16 data chips; final board placement and connector drawing pending.
specification.installation: Power off; matched density and qualified speed within each pair. No incomplete bank or mixed module density in one chassis in v1.
specification.electrical_interface: Shared edge interface target; module-specific PCB routing. Rails, pinout, keying, decoupling and buffer population must be frozen before manufacture.

data.product_status: Accepted production design baseline; electrical timing, supplier and full-population qualification pending.
manufacturing_requirements: Sixteen AION 64K x 1 chips per module; PRO and bank kits use matched qualified grades. Keep purchased 64K supplier as a separately qualified contingency, with no automatic substitution or price saving.
